title: 从连续预测变量到临床阈值：基于指南分类对缺血性卒中结局预测性能权衡的早期证据
summary: 该研究探讨在急性缺血性卒中90天结局预测中，用临床指南对齐的分类编码替代连续预测变量是否影响模型性能。在多中心欧洲登记数据上，完全分类的梯度提升模型在两个治疗队列中与连续模型无显著差异，一个队列性能显著下降，但特征重要性排序保持一致，表明指南分类是可行的设计选择。
summary_en: This study examines whether replacing continuous predictors with guideline-aligned categorical encodings affects performance in 90-day outcome prediction for acute ischaemic stroke. Fully categorised gradient-boosted models were statistically indistinguishable from continuous counterparts in two treatment cohorts, with a significant drop in one, while feature importance rankings remained consistent, suggesting guideline-based categorisation is viable.
